kurz: Acid and time have turned the [[chlorophyll-farbe|chlorophyll]] into an olive-brown pigment.
bild_im_kopf: Like a freshly painted garden fence weathering: heat and acid turn green into olive grey in minutes.

ursachen.warum: The longer it cooks, the more acid leaks out and dulls the green.
fix: Refresh in cold water straight away

ursachen.warum: Lemon, vinegar or tomatoes in the pot speed up the colour change.
Even after cooking, warmth keeps changing the green.
fix: Cook the vegetables separately and mix just before serving

q1.frage: How long did the vegetables cook?

q2.frage: Was there acid in the pot, or did they sit in a sauce for long?
